beats.label: S1 · Three lives at 36
beats.text: Kevin quits his sitcom mid-taping, Kate meets Toby at a support group, and Randall tracks down the birth father who abandoned him as a newborn.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the Big Three at the inflection points that drive every subsequent season.

beats.label: S1 · The 1980 truth
beats.text: Flashbacks reveal one triplet died at birth; the Pearsons adopted the Black baby abandoned at the fire station that day, and Jack—seen only in memory—is long dead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the dual timeline and Jack-is-dead premise the entire show is built on.

beats.label: S1 · William moves in
beats.text: Randall brings the terminally ill William home; Beth discovers Rebecca has secretly known William since Randall was a baby and hid it from Jack for decades.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the season's central bomb—Rebecca's 36-year secret—which detonates at Thanksgiving.

beats.label: S1 · The letter
beats.text: At Thanksgiving Randall discovers Rebecca's 36-year lie; the confrontation freezes the family, and Kate announces she plans to have gastric bypass surgery.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fractures Randall/Rebecca and shifts Kate onto her weight-loss arc that becomes her S2 pregnancy path.

beats.label: S1 · William's Memphis goodbye
beats.text: Randall drives William to Memphis for a final homecoming; William dies with Randall beside him, and Randall later quits his high-pressure job.
beats.whyLoadBearing: William's death and Randall's quitting free him to want to adopt, which becomes S2's engine.

beats.label: S1 · Kevin and Kate pivot
beats.text: Kevin's play succeeds; he reunites with ex-wife Sophie and takes a Ron Howard film role. Kate accepts Toby's proposal and vows to pursue singing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Positions Kevin's LA career and Kate's engagement/singing dreams as the S2 storylines.

beats.label: S1 · Ready to adopt
beats.text: With his career blown up and William gone, Randall tells Beth he wants to adopt a baby—reopening the family's story of chosen children.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Direct setup for Deja's arrival in S2.

cliffhanger.text: The William secret has just cracked open and reset the Pearsons: Randall has walked away from his career, Kevin is heading off to meet Ron Howard, Kate is chasing music with Toby, and no one has yet said how Jack died.
questions: What child will Randall bring into the family?
Can Kate live with the guilt she carries about Jack?

characters.name: Jack Pearson
characters.line: The Big Three's late father, seen only in flashback; died at some unspecified point after they became teenagers.

characters.name: Rebecca Pearson
characters.line: Mother of the Big Three; her 36-year secret about William nearly cost her Randall.

characters.name: Randall Pearson
characters.line: Adopted businessman who just quit his high-pressure job and told Beth he wants to adopt a baby.

characters.name: Kevin Pearson
characters.line: Actor who left his sitcom for Broadway, reunited with ex-wife Sophie, and is heading to LA for a Ron Howard film.

characters.name: Kate Pearson
characters.line: Personal assistant newly engaged to Toby; blames herself for Jack's death and has committed to singing.

characters.name: Beth Pearson
characters.line: Randall's wife; the one who forced Rebecca's William secret into the open.

characters.name: William Hill
characters.line: Randall's biological father; met his son, moved in, and died of cancer in Memphis.

characters.name: Toby Damon
characters.line: Kate's fiancé; funny, cardiac patient, wholly devoted to her.

characters.name: Miguel Rivas
characters.line: Jack's best friend, now married to Rebecca.

beats.label: S2 · Fostering Deja
beats.text: Randall and Beth foster twelve-year-old Deja, whose mother Shauna is in prison; Randall pours himself into earning her trust.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Deja becomes the character Randall's fatherhood arc orbits for the rest of the show.

beats.label: S2 · Kevin's spiral
beats.text: A film-set knee reinjury tips Kevin into painkiller addiction; he wrecks his relationship with Sophie and is arrested for drunk driving with Tess in the back seat.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kevin's addiction reshapes every family relationship and drives him into rehab, then Vietnam.

beats.label: S2 · Kate loses the baby
beats.text: Kate miscarries early in her pregnancy; the family regroups at Kevin's rehab, where he unloads a lifetime of feeling like the family's 'fifth wheel.'
beats.whyLoadBearing: Miscarriage sets Kate's IVF path; rehab confession reorders the sibling dynamic going forward.

beats.label: S2 · How Jack died
beats.text: On the twentieth anniversary Jack's death is dramatised: a faulty slow cooker burns down the house, and Jack dies the next morning of cardiac arrest from smoke inhalation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Answers the show's biggest mystery; the fire and heart attack become permanent reference points.

beats.label: S2 · Deja returns
beats.text: Deja goes back to Shauna when charges drop, but months later Shauna signs over parental rights; Deja returns to the Pearsons for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Deja is now permanently a Pearson daughter.

beats.label: S2 · Kate and Toby marry
beats.text: Kate scatters the last of Jack's ashes to make room for Toby; they marry, but a flash-forward warns Toby will soon be cripplingly depressed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Wedding launches their marriage; the flash-forward pre-loads Toby's S3 depression arc.

beats.label: S2 · A brother in Vietnam
beats.text: Kevin finds a photo of Jack in Vietnam beside a never-mentioned brother; a flash-forward shows Kevin flying there with Zoe, Beth's cousin turned girlfriend.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the Vietnam / lost-brother storyline that dominates S3.

cliffhanger.text: The Pearsons finally know how Jack died, but they've just learned he had a brother nobody knew about. Kate is newly married, Kevin is sober and pointed at Vietnam with Zoe, and a future glimpse warns Toby is about to fall apart.
questions: Who is Jack's brother and is he still alive?
What will Kevin uncover in Vietnam?
Can Kate hold her marriage together as Toby's depression returns?

characters.name: Kevin Pearson

characters.name: Kate Pearson
characters.line: Newly married to Toby after a mid-season miscarriage; committed to singing.

characters.name: Toby Damon
characters.line: Kate's husband; a flash-forward warns his depression will soon return catastrophically.

characters.name: Rebecca Pearson
characters.line: The Big Three's mother; still married to Miguel.

characters.name: Beth Pearson
characters.line: Randall's wife; second mother to Deja.

characters.name: Deja
characters.line: Twelve-year-old permanently in the Pearsons' care after her mother Shauna signed over parental rights.

characters.name: Miguel Rivas
characters.line: Jack's best friend and Rebecca's husband; a steady adult presence.

characters.name: Zoe Baker
characters.line: Beth's cousin and Kevin's new girlfriend; travelling with him to Vietnam.

beats.label: S3 · Jack in Vietnam
beats.text: Extended flashbacks reveal Jack enlisted in Vietnam to find his troubled younger brother Nicky, whose story Kevin now chases with Zoe.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Vietnam becomes the season's spine and reframes who Jack was.

beats.label: S3 · Councilman Randall
beats.text: Randall wins a Philadelphia city council seat and drags Beth into a life she never chose; her long-buried career grievances begin to surface.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Launches Randall's political life and Beth's grievance that dominates the marriage story.

beats.label: S3 · Nicky lives
beats.text: Kevin learns Nicky did not die in the war; the siblings find him in a Pennsylvania trailer, where he confesses the accident that estranged him from Jack.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Nicky joins the family orbit permanently, remaking Kevin's world and the family.

beats.label: S3 · Jack Jr. arrives early
beats.text: Kate and Toby's IVF works, but Toby secretly stops his antidepressants and spirals; Kate delivers Jack at 28 weeks—premature and fighting for life.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Baby Jack's precariousness defines Kate and Toby's next several seasons.

beats.label: S3 · Kevin loses Zoe
beats.text: Kevin relapses the day of Jack Jr.'s birth; when Zoe sees he wants the fatherhood she does not, she ends the relationship.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kevin re-enters S4 single and available for the Cassidy/Madison arcs.

beats.label: S3 · Beth breaks
beats.text: Beth accuses Randall of consuming her life; after a night apart they agree to move to Philadelphia and let Beth open her own dance studio.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the marriage on new terms and moves the family to Philly for good.

beats.label: S3 · A future glimpse
beats.text: A future flash-forward shows the family gathering at Kevin's home around an elderly, failing Rebecca; Nicky is with them and Kevin has a preteen son.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Previews Rebecca's decline and Kevin's eventual fatherhood, anchoring S4 stakes.

cliffhanger.text: The Pearsons are scattered—Randall and Beth reinventing themselves in Philadelphia, Kate and Toby fighting for a fragile newborn, Kevin single after losing Zoe, Nicky freshly back in the family. A future flash promises an aged Rebecca is in trouble.
questions: Will baby Jack survive the NICU?
Can Randall and Beth make Philadelphia work?
What is happening to Rebecca in the future?

characters.name: Beth Pearson

characters.name: Kate Pearson

characters.name: Toby Damon

characters.name: Rebecca Pearson
characters.line: The Big Three's mother; a future flash shows her aging into failing health.

characters.name: Nicky Pearson

characters.name: Deja
characters.line: The Pearsons' adopted teenage daughter.

characters.name: Miguel Rivas
characters.line: Rebecca's husband.

beats.label: S4 · Cassidy and Malik arrive
beats.text: Two new arrivals reshape the Pearsons: veteran Cassidy Sharp joins Nicky's recovery, and teenage Malik meets Deja on her first day in Philadelphia.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cassidy anchors Kevin/Nicky's world; Malik becomes Deja's long-term partner.

beats.label: S4 · Kevin and Cassidy
beats.text: Kevin buys the trailer next to Nicky's; while shepherding Cassidy through her collapsing marriage, the two sleep together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cassidy becomes Kevin's confidante for years and reshapes his sober life.

beats.label: S4 · Rebecca's diagnosis
beats.text: Randall notices Rebecca's memory slipping; she is diagnosed with mild cognitive impairment, and Miguel admits he had been quietly denying it for months.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rebecca's dementia becomes the spine of the rest of the series.

beats.label: S4 · Randall in therapy
beats.text: A home intruder triggers Randall's long-buried anxiety; after a hero moment and a breakdown to Kevin, he enters therapy for the first time.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Therapy becomes the vehicle for Randall's William/Laurel discoveries in S5.

beats.label: S4 · Madison is pregnant
beats.text: House-sitting for Kate, Madison sleeps with Kevin; she learns she is pregnant with twins, and Kevin commits to fatherhood without hesitation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The twins become the next Pearson generation and root Kevin's S5 arc.

beats.label: S4 · The brothers break
beats.text: Randall pushes Rebecca to enter a St. Louis clinical trial; at baby Jack's first birthday, Kevin and Randall exchange insults that leave them estranged.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The brothers' rupture is the wound S5 has to spend a whole season healing.

beats.label: S4 · New chapters begin
beats.text: Rebecca commits to the trial; Kate and Toby decide to adopt a sibling for Jack—the future daughter Hailey glimpsed in a flash-forward.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rebecca on the trial and the adoption plan set the two biggest S5 storylines in motion.

cliffhanger.text: Rebecca has agreed to the clinical trial, Kevin and Randall have said things they cannot unsay, Madison is carrying Kevin's twins, and Kate and Toby are ready to adopt. A future glimpse hints at a daughter named Hailey.
questions: Will the trial slow Rebecca's decline?
Can Kevin and Randall find their way back to each other?
What kind of father will Kevin be to the twins?

characters.name: Malik

beats.label: S5 · Turning 40 in lockdown
beats.text: The Big Three turn 40 in pandemic lockdown; Kevin is sober and engaged to pregnant Madison.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Anchors the season in COVID and sets Kevin/Madison's engagement as the arc to watch.

beats.label: S5 · Kate confronts Marc
beats.text: Kate reveals to Toby the abusive teenage relationship she'd buried, and drives to San Diego to confront her ex Marc face to face.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kate's confrontation is the closing chapter on her defining teenage trauma.

beats.label: S5 · Randall meets Hai
beats.text: Randall learns his birth mother Laurel survived her overdose; she lived years out of prison with a Vietnamese man, Hai, thinking of Randall every day.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Randall finally has his birth mother's true story—a shift he carries into S6.

beats.label: S5 · The new Big Three
beats.text: Madison delivers Kevin's twins Nicholas and Frances; the same night, Kate and Toby's adopted daughter Hailey arrives—the new Big Three.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The next Pearson generation is now on the board.

beats.label: S5 · Kate and Toby drift
beats.text: Kate takes a teaching job at Jack Jr.'s music school as Toby accepts one that pulls him to San Francisco three days a week.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Their separate lives set up the marriage failure that opens S6.

beats.label: S5 · The wedding that isn't
beats.text: On the wedding day Madison realises Kevin does not love her; they call it off, and Rebecca hands Kevin a mission—to build the house Jack once promised her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kevin re-enters S6 unmarried and with a purpose that structures his life.

beats.label: S5 · Five years on
beats.text: Flash-forwards show Kate about to marry her boss Phillip, Nicky married, Randall a rising political star, and Kevin sharing a hotel room with someone unseen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Previews the S6 milestones—new wedding, Kevin's mystery partner, Randall's politics.

cliffhanger.text: Kevin and Madison have called off the wedding on the day; Kevin is charged with building the house Jack always promised Rebecca. Kate and Toby are quietly drifting apart, and flash-forwards promise Kate will remarry Phillip and Kevin will end up with someone still unseen.
questions: Who is Kevin sharing that hotel room with in the future?
Can Kate and Toby survive Toby's San Francisco life?
How much longer does Rebecca have?

characters.name: Nicky Pearson

characters.name: Phillip

beats.label: S6 · Life at 41
beats.text: On their 41st birthday, Rebecca's Alzheimer's is deepening and Kevin lives in Madison's garage while she moves on with Elijah.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the final-season stakes: Rebecca's decline and Kevin's homelessness in his own life.

beats.label: S6 · Kate and Toby end
beats.text: After Jack Jr. wanders off during their fight, Kate and Toby accept their marriage is over and divorce peacefully for their children's sake.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Kate/Toby marriage arc that has run since S1.

beats.label: S6 · Kate marries Phillip
beats.text: Years pass: Kate marries her boss Phillip, Toby offers his blessing with a new partner beside him, and freshly sworn-in Senator Randall toasts the family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The flash-forwards land: Kate's remarriage and Randall's political rise are now the present.

beats.label: S6 · Kevin and Sophie
beats.text: After his broken engagement, Kevin drifts until Sophie—divorced and back from working abroad—arrives at Kate's wedding; they reconcile as the family cheers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes Kevin's romantic arc with his first love.

beats.label: S6 · Miguel dies
beats.text: Miguel, worn from years of caring for Rebecca, dies; his ashes are scattered in Puerto Rico and by the apple tree he planted with her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Rebecca's caregiver and forces the Big Three to close ranks around her.

beats.label: S6 · Rebecca on the train
beats.text: The Big Three converge on Rebecca's deathbed; Kate flies in from England, and Rebecca dies as an imagined train delivers her back to Jack.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's emotional climax and the show's turning point.

beats.label: S6 · What comes next
beats.text: At Rebecca's funeral, Deja tells Randall her unborn son will be named William; the Big Three vow not to drift, and Randall considers a presidential run.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The series closes forward-looking rather than backward—the Pearson story continues.

cliffhanger.text: The show has ended. Rebecca and Miguel are gone, Kate is married to Philip, Kevin is back with Sophie, Randall is a senator eyeing higher office, and Deja will name her son William. The Big Three have promised each other they will not drift.
questions: How does the next Pearson generation carry the family forward?
Can the Big Three keep the promise they made at Rebecca's funeral?
